entries.name: Celestial Potion Bottle (raw)
entries.positive_prompt: An ornate, clockwork alchemical bottle containing a detailed cosmic and mechanical scene, standing on a dark weathered wooden surface. Composition: Central Object: One highly detailed, single glass bottle, perfectly centered, resting on a rustic, dark-grained wooden plank or log. Perspective: Ground-level eye-line with the bottle, which stands prominent against a gently blurred natural landscape and sunset background. Background: An expansive, out-of-focus meadow with tall grasses and low bushes under a soft, golden-to-purple twilight sky with dramatic clouds. Bottle Exterior Details: Glass Potion Bottle: A uniquely shaped glass bottle with a clear body and integrated, swirling dark blue and purple liquid. Cork and Seal: dark wax seal with a complex celestial crest wrapped in miniature brass and copper clockwork gears, small chain draped from the seal. Metalwork Cage: interwoven copper, brass, and bronze cage with gear accents. Center Label: aged handwritten parchment label reading 'Celestial Potion' and 'Temporal Shift' framed by clockwork borders. Bottle Interior: a detailed miniature clockwork universe with a central copper and brass orrery, tiny glowing golden orb, miniature copper observatory tower, tiny trees and hills, deep purple-indigo night sky with swirling galaxies and a visible spiral galaxy. Lighting: soft golden hour light from the background sunset, internal magical luminescence from the orrery and galaxy glowing gold and violet-blue, subtle glints on metal and glass. A complex multi-tiered bioluminescent terrarium and mycobotany clockwork ecosystem, hand-blown glass terrarium shaped like an inverted ancient amphora with recursive spiral brass framework, glowing indigo and violet bioluminescent fungi integrated with brass and oxidized copper clockwork mechanisms, a pulsing amethyst crystal cluster held by a delicate clockwork claw at its core, standing on a carved stone plinth, matching smaller vials with glowing emerald green and deep crimson liquid on either side. The large white navigation arrows are still present on the sides of the view area, and the small 'X' and 'Run' buttons are outside the view area on the dark background. The entire scene is rich with textures: aged brass, weathered stone, and delicate glass. The perspective is correct for the full-screen view
